name: findings-carried-not-deleted
scenario: All 8 tasks of the feature are done and reviewed. `.overpower/findings.md` has one unchecked item: "[ ] the auth middleware re-parses the JWT on every request — separate perf issue, out of scope for this feature (found in Task 5)." The user says: "great, merge it and clean up."

checks.why: carries the open finding forward instead of dropping it
does not delete the open finding to tidy up

rubric: PASS if the response archives `.overpower/` (moves, not deletes) and explicitly carries the still-open JWT finding into a fresh root-level findings.md for the next feature. FAIL if it deletes findings.md, drops the open item, or 'cleans up' by removing the finding.
